purpose: Conservative preliminary annotations for dubbing preparation. These are not audio-derived performance judgments.

basis: adjacent subtitle context for limited emotional continuity
cue timing and punctuation for pause opportunities only
limitations: No source audio/video was analyzed for these labels.
Do not treat inferred emotion as actor-confirmed emotion.
Do not assign pitch, loudness, whispering, shouting, crying, laughter, breath, or vocal intensity unless explicitly supported by subtitle wording or later audio review.
A timing gap is only a pause opportunity, not proof of a pause or breath.
methodology.confidence: medium is used only for explicit textual cues; low indicates functional defaults or contextual possibilities.

voice_identity_rule: Vivienne C001 remains one voice identity across dialogue, narration, and inner monologue. Narration and inner_monologue are delivery/function modes, not separate speakers.
